cohort: The study included 70 women, comprising cases who underwent caesarean sections and an equal number of age-matched controls who underwent normal deliveries, from tertiary care hospitals in Mangalore, India.
finding: The study found that older women (above 30 years), primigravida, and primipara were associated with emergency LSCS, while moderate physical work and a mixed diet were observed among those undergoing full term vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Older women (above 30 years) and primigravida/primipara were observed to have undergone emergency LSCS rather than vaginal deliveries.
cross-section timing: The study period for data collection was 12th April 2016 to 22nd April 2016.
